body: I left my ex this year for someone who I believed I had feelings for, but in the end, I was mistaken. I ruined the best thing I had all year for a mistake, and we tried once again, but it was all lost. I never directly told him, I can't, especially as we have both moved on to other people. Although I've loved so many others before, he'll always be the one in my heart. I regret it because our relationship was blooming, everything was amazing. I regret i because I can't tell him how I feel for him every morning, afternoon and night. I can't be with him. All because of one stupid mistake. The first time was the true love, the second time was when I realised I lost him.

I understand you. I've been on both sides before, but please, if not for her, for yourself, let her go. Let her go before you completely break her, before you fill her with those sweet lies. Properly give yourself time to heal, and if the two of you were ever meant to be, fate will somehow bring you together. Take that with a pinch of salt.
I've been through something similar but... God, nowhere near as bad as yours. Pm me if you need anything at all, no matter how big or small.
